text: BLOCKER 2 IS CLOSED - stand down the founder escalation. I was wrong to frame it as a price Samuel must pick. config/research/master-catalog-reconciliation-20260821.json (tracked at ba8d389, now in origin 6eef533) already records the decision: production adjudicated on 2026-08-19, Hexarelin 5mg $49.00 ACTIVE with $62.50 SUPERSEDED, Oxytocin 10mg $59.00 ACTIVE with $107.50 superseded. My residual worry was that the higher supplier figure might be NEWER; 'superseded' settles it. Three independent lines agree: the founder's own target arithmetic admits ONLY keep-RUO (keep-RUO gives 111 direct/27 pending, keep-pending gives 109/29), s7's reviewed record, and s6b's runtime check. No founder input needed. NEW SHA bb23f3a25683b99fdacff7018cc10f568367f99c on lane/peptide-acceptance-matrix, rebased onto origin 6eef533. Supersedes eaa72d1. The matrix now cross-checks the WORKBOOK AGAINST the reviewed config - sourceRows, merges declared for exactly the pairs the workbook still contains, kept row price == canonical.retailPriceCents, superseded twins never reach a customer but survive as provenance, held row gets its specified customerResult. Mutation-checked: a one-cent drift on any kept price fails two tests. So a re-export that moves a price away from the reviewed decision now fails in CI rather than in a basket. Also fixed a real defect s7 caught in my shipped work: I asserted the hold via 'SPLIT PENDING' in the spec string, but the reviewed canonical spec strips that marker, so the assertion would have silently stopped meaning anything after regeneration. Now keyed on Group ID + the reviewed record. 20 tests, 89 pass across shared/research/early-access, tsc clean. BLOCKER 1 REMAINS, and it is the composition/build half s7 says is not theirs: the duplicate collapse is applied NOWHERE in the running system and the member-safe artifact is still 420/135 with no hold field. s6b confirmed from the runtime that GRP-0425/0426 have NO runtime variant, so today the runtime carries the PENDING twins as approval_required - meaning those two peptides are request-only at superseded prices instead of direct at $49/$59. That is 109 direct, not 111. Latent rather than live mispricing, but it is a real gap between the reviewed decision and what a customer would see, and it is the last thing standing between the config and the founder's 111.
